mentions.name: Docket
mentions.description: A simple, free (ad-supported) iOS app for tracking expenses and receipts, built as a no-subscription alternative to existing expense tracking services.
mentions.problem: Existing expense tracking apps are all subscription-based, adding a recurring monthly cost just to track simple expenses.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a simple iOS app that's free (ad supported) for tracking expenses/receipts. Everything out there was subscriptions and I didn't want another monthly expense to track my simple expenses ...
http://loomlabs.au/docket
